hypertension: Do not stop or skip your blood pressure medication without calling our office first.
Take your medication at the same time each morning, with water.
Stand up slowly — a higher dose can cause dizziness when you first start.
Call us if your blood pressure is above 180/120, or if you have chest pain, severe headache, or shortness of breath.
Limit salt and alcohol; both can raise blood pressure.
diabetes: Take medications exactly as prescribed — do not adjust doses on your own.
Call us if you have repeated low blood sugar episodes or feel unwell.
Keep your follow-up lab work appointments.
default: Contact the clinic if your symptoms worsen or you have urgent concerns.
Follow the medication and lifestyle guidance discussed at your visit.

emergencyNotice: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department.
